en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 8. And with the preceding chains of narration from ‘Ali ibn Mahzyar, from al-Nadhr, from Ibrahim ibn Abdul Hamid, from Zaid ibn al-Shahham who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, say: "Beware of the dominant power of Allah, during the night and during the day."
I asked: "What is that dominant power?" He said: "When He seizes you for the sins."
